messages:
oliver: Heads-up — console shows both v1 and v2 badges for /generate in some tenants. UX confusing.

sujata: Can you paste tenant id?

oliver: acme-payments. Badge says v2 recommended but traffic graph is 100% v1. Screenshot uploaded.

aj: Likely telemetry join issue — console reads config and metrics separately.

maria: Badge logic currently prefers preferredVariant from cache or recentRollout flag. We need clearer precedence.

kevin: Did router change the variant tag format last quarter?

aj: Router emits X-Variant=v2-beta for canary. Metrics normalization maps 'v2' but not 'v2-beta'.

linda: Unknown suffixes map to 'other' in analytics so console mismatches.

oliver: Customers think console lied. Proposal: derive active badge from serving metrics if recent traffic >1% else show preferred. Tooltip to explain discrepancy.

sujata: Tooltip fine short-term. Long-term: metrics should win for 'active' label; config shown as 'preferred'.

maria: That requires waiting for metrics before rendering or showing a loading state.

aj: Alternative: show both with a confidence meter (green if agree, amber if small skew, red if big skew). No blocking render.

kevin: More realtime reads raise QPS on metrics store. Cost check needed.
linda: Cheap option: query router counters (per-tenant per-variant) instead of full TSDB.

maria: Plan: 1) add confidence UI, 2) use router counters for initial badge, 3) tooltip with last-5m percent, 4) background reconcile with TSDB.

sujata: PM ok. Timeline?

aj: Estimate: UI + router-counter read prototype 2w, backend QA + rollout 1w, flagged rollout 1w => ~4w.

oliver: Edge: tenant pins should override and be clearly marked as "Pinned to v1 by tenant".

maria: We'll make pin copy & lock icon more prominent.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: console/ui-service v2.14.7 -> canary.

aj: Put feature behind flag `console.variant_confidence_ui`, enable internal first.

linda: I'll add ingestion mapping for suffixes (v2-*, v2beta -> v2) to reduce false 'other'.

kevin: Recommend an internal debug banner showing raw variant_label vs normalized to audit issues.

oliver: Also please add a dashboard tile for "variant mismatches" (count routes where config != serving) so PMs can track migrations.

sujata: PMs will use that to decide pausing rollouts.

maria: I'll add a Route Health card: mismatches (5m), top tenants, recent examples.

aj: Action items: @maria implement confidence UI + pin copy change (2w); @linda add suffix mapping (1w); @aj add router-counter read endpoint + debug banner (2w); @kevin capacity check on router counter QPS (ASAP); @sujata create PM ticket for dashboard tile.

oliver: Thanks all. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: canary deployment completed: console/ui-service v2.14.7 on console-canary-3 succeeded.

linda: I'll baseline the mismatch metric and report tomorrow morning.
